K4 prod+int64 itemsize=8 -> loops at 256KiB. K5 amax+fp8 input_load_itemsize=1 -> narrow-w1 lever fires (w1, occupancy-gated). K9b var(2-pass)+bf16 itemsize floored to 4 -> loops at 256KiB (the bf16 fp32-accumulator fix bites exactly). K11/K12 cumsum/scan: itemsize recorded as 0, but _resident_itemsize=max(4,0)=4 governs the persist(8192,fits)/loop(131072,512KiB) decision correctly. K13 wide user-tiled bf16 prime 50021 -> R_BLOCK=16384 looped. Every itemsize boundary (0/1/2/8) is robustly absorbed by max(4,itemsize); op-identity is correctly exempt.

The heuristic correctly declines to size a malformed grid-collapse; the real defect is the upstream idiom miscompile (matches the known working-as-intended correctness-guard case). Neither matches the two closed predicates by analogy -- both are read from real provenance (an upstream lowering raise; a PARTIAL_GRID classification + verified miscompile).

Found NO new RED, NO UNREACHED cells, NO missing axis. >=6 fresh novel kernels minted (13), none copied/parameterized from the corpus-avoid-list. Certifying dry.
